title: Quasi-finite polynomial charts at a fibre point
statement: Let $X,T$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $f:X\to T$ locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. For every $y\in X$ there are an affine open neighborhood $U$ of $y$, an integer $n\ge0$, and a locally finitely presented, locally quasi-finite morphism $e:U\to\mathbb A^n_T$ [pqf-def-quasifinite; def-nagata-relative-affine-space] such that $e$ followed by the projection to $T$ equals $f|_U$, and the topological Krull dimension of $X_{f(y)}$ at its point corresponding to $y$ is $n$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point].

source.place: Tag 00QE, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00QE, and its affine translation in the first paragraph of the proof of Tag 00RH; read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Write X = Spec B and T = Spec A via their affine isomorphisms. The coordinate homomorphism is finitely presented, hence finite type. The fibre ring F at the image of y is a finite type algebra over its residue field. Apply the finite-type field dimension-at-point formula to its distinguished prime: it supplies finite natural numbers d,r with dimension at that point equal to n = d+r. The affine fibre identification preserves the point and its dimension.

Apply the quasi-finite-over-polynomial-algebra theorem to A, B, the prime of y, and n. Obtain b outside that prime and an A-algebra homomorphism A[t_1,...,t_n] to B[1/b] that is finite type and quasi-finite at every prime.

The spectrum of B[1/b] is the affine principal open D(b). Transport its spectrum morphism to e from this open U to affine n-space over T. Compatibility with A gives e followed by projection equal to f restricted to U. The finite type polynomial source and finite presentation over A give finite presentation of the polynomial map by RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_comp_finiteType (Mathlib/RingTheory/FinitePresentation.lean); localization away is finitely presented. Replace the finite variable index by its ULift using polynomial renaming. These canonical isomorphisms preserve the asserted properties and the dimension equality at y.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_quasiFinite_polynomial_chart
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine T]
    (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (y : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffine U.toScheme) (hy : y ∈ U) (n : ℕ)
      (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation e ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite e ∧
      e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
